newsitem.title: GERMANY: Former Mercedes truck chief to head German group.
newsitem.headline: Former Mercedes truck chief to head German group.

text.p: The VDA German automobile association said on Wednesday that the former top executive at the truck unit of Mercedes-Benz AG has been appointed the association's new president.
A VDA spokesman said members will vote on approving Bernd Gottschalk, who unexpectedly resigned his post in July, as the new association president at a weekend meeting.

Gottschalk, 53, will replace outgoing VDA President Erika Emmerich, who has held the position since 1989 and has said she wanted to step down. Gottschalk will take up his new position at the start of 1997.
Analysts have said that Gottschalk's resignation from Mercedes likely reflected differences on how to cut costs and to control the unit against the will of Mercedes chief executive Helmut Werner.
